page_title: SHU 0-1 CRY | Sheffield Utd v Crystal Palace 12/08/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+5' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) shows too much aggression during an attacking move and ends up fouling his opponent.
90+3' Oliver Norwood (Sheffield Utd) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
90+2' The referee signals a substitution. James Tomkins (Crystal Palace) is brought on as a substitute for Marc Guehi.
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
87' Paul Heckingbottom has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Antwoine Hackford (Sheffield Utd) replacing Benie Traore.
87' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Andre Brooks (Sheffield Utd) comes onto the pitch for Ben Osborn.

87' What a save from Wesley Foderingham! Joachim Andersen (Crystal Palace) jumps high to meet a cross and glances a promising low header from close range, but the goalkeeper pulls off a brilliant stop to keep it out.
86' Anis Slimane (Sheffield Utd) is shown a yellow card by the referee for making a challenge on his opponent, but he looks angry with the decision.

84' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and shoots. His poorly placed shot flies well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Sheffield Utd.
80' The referee allows time for a substitution. Max Lowe will be replaced by Yasser Larouci (Sheffield Utd).
80' Here is a change. Chris Basham is going off and Paul Heckingbottom gives the last tactical orders to Vini Souza (Sheffield Utd).
80' Substitution. Jack Robinson did his best and is replaced by Anis Slimane (Sheffield Utd).
79' Great teamplay by Crystal Palace as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
76' Benie Traore (Sheffield Utd) has again attempted to split the defence with a through ball.

75' Nice move, nice attempt! William Osula (Sheffield Utd) is teed up with a simple pass after a nice flowing move. His first time shot from mid-range looks like it's going in but curls just wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Crystal Palace.
74' Corner kick. Oliver Norwood (Sheffield Utd) is ready to send the ball into the box.
72' Wesley Foderingham pulls off a great save to deny Jeffrey Schlupp (Crystal Palace), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick shot to the left side of the goal.
70' A goal, which was scored by Odsonne Edouard (Crystal Palace), was disallowed due to offside.
66' Joachim Andersen (Crystal Palace) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and John Brooks blows for a foul.
62' Ben Osborn (Sheffield Utd) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
60' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) will take the corner.
57' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Anel Ahmedhodzic (Sheffield Utd) was quite harsh and John Brooks didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
56' William Osula (Sheffield Utd) commits a rough challenge and John Brooks blows his whistle for a foul.
54' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal from a mid-range free kick, but the ball is blocked by the defensive wall.
50' 0 - 1 Jordan Ayew plays a terrific cross over to Odsonne Edouard (Crystal Palace), who finds some space inside the box and puts the ball into the back of the net.
47' Oliver Norwood (Sheffield Utd) sends a long ball in, but Sam Johnstone comfortably gathers the ball.
46' The second half has just started.
45+2' John Brooks has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+1' John Brooks blows his whistle after Jefferson Lerma (Crystal Palace) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle.
45' We will have 1 min. of added time.

44' Oliver Norwood (Sheffield Utd) gets into a good scoring position. He creates some space for himself and tries his luck from distance. His decent effort towards the middle of the goal is, however, saved by Sam Johnstone!
42' The Crystal Palace players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
40' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 3:12.
38' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.
37' The Sheffield Utd players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
34' Sheffield Utd win a corner.
34' George Baldock (Sheffield Utd) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The referee signals a corner kick to Sheffield Utd.
32' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) takes the corner but it's cleared.
30' Cheick Doucoure (Crystal Palace) drills a powerful shot from long range towards the middle of the goal, but Wesley Foderingham makes a comfortable save.
27' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Sheffield Utd.
25' Crystal Palace seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
23' Crystal Palace have been awarded a corner kick.
22' The assistant referee raises his flag and the referee blows his whistle. Jordan Ayew (Crystal Palace) puts the ball into the net, but he is flagged for offside.

20' Odsonne Edouard (Crystal Palace) connected with a pass around the edge of the box, aimed and shot. His attempt went towards the bottom left corner, but Wesley Foderingham was alert and the score remains the same.
20' Crystal Palace enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
18' The ball is out of play and Sheffield Utd manage to earn a corner.
16' William Osula (Sheffield Utd) gets a yellow card.
14' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.

14' Odsonne Edouard (Crystal Palace) goes on a mazy run and tries his luck with a mid-range strike, but one of the defending players steps in and makes a block. Crystal Palace force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
12' Jeffrey Schlupp (Crystal Palace) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
11' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.

9' William Osula (Sheffield Utd) unleashes a cannonball of a shot from the edge of the area, but it zips narrowly wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Crystal Palace will have a goal kick.
7' The resulting set piece from Sheffield Utd is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
7' 58:42 – the latest ball possession ratio.
3' Ben Osborn (Sheffield Utd) fouls an opponent during an attacking move.
2' Neat passing move from Sheffield Utd in order to create new attacking opportunities.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
John Brooks got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
